state_reasons: heretic variant: parent quality is reference only and no exact-variant evaluation exists

policy.rationale: Publication readiness is reported honestly even when it is zero. Non-zero counts are never manufactured by relaxing a gate.
source_assumptions: Phase 6 recommendation policy remains authoritative for tier eligibility.
A quantized artifact without direct comparable retention evidence is never presented as equally evidenced to its base release.
An alignment-modified variant never inherits its parent's quality score.
A measurement on a larger GPU is memory-requirement evidence, not hardware verification on the target tier.
A missing evidence domain lowers a state; it never raises one.
